messages:
Elena (CEO): @here quick follow-up from today's all-hands — we're doing a short live Q&A focused on customer signal triage: why we won/lost and the top asks from customers. Post short questions and we'll answer live. :wave:
Jia (Sales): Quick one — biggest loss last quarter cited latency spikes under burst load. Is there a roadmap item to reduce tail latency?
Marco (VP Product): Short answer: yes. We're running a tail-latency campaign: kernel-level optimizations + smarter autoscaling. Target: Q3 beta for Dedicated autoscale policy tuning. Will share PRD.
Sam (Eng): Can you clarify if this is infra-only or will there be API changes? Our customers want a 'low-latency' contract on a per-route basis.
Marco (VP Product): Infra + API flags. We'll add route-level latency SLOs and a 'prefer-low-latency' routing hint. No breaking changes — opt-in initial rollout.
Priya (Customer Success): From churn calls, another theme: onboarding friction — customers get stuck mapping prompts to models. Ask: better defaults + mapping templates?
Anya (Growth): Also seeing asks for a sandbox that mirrors production perf for engineering trials. Free tier doesn't reproduce tail behaviour.
Elena (CEO): Agree. Action: Priya + Anya + Marco to draft an 'onboarding perf kit' (templates + sandbox config). Can you have a draft in two weeks?
Priya (Customer Success): On it. I'll loop in two top churn accounts for short interviews.
Sam (Eng): Implementation note: sandbox will need a small dedicated pool with perf parity; needs pricing alignment. @Ravi (Finance) FYI.
Ravi (Finance): Got it. I'll model cost for a 2x sandbox pool and propose a subsidized trial SKU.
Jia (Sales): Another win pattern — customers who used Redwood Optimize recommendations saw ~25% cost drop without quality loss. They want more automated suggestions in the console.
Marco (VP Product): We're expanding Optimize to include model-recommendation A/B test pipelines. ETA: Q4.
Sam (Eng): On losses — some customers reported 'mystery regresses' after model rollouts. We should add pre-rollout eval gates tied to customer prompt sets.
Elena (CEO): Yes — rolling this to top priority. Research + Eng to ship 'customer-scoped preflight' next quarter. Also: we'll publish an async follow-up doc with owners and timelines.
dev-bot: deploy-notice: Created doc at https://redwood.internal/doc/ah-followup-1865432100 - owners: Marco, Priya, Sam
Marco (VP Product): Thanks — will update the PRD there. Anything else?
Jia (Sales): One ask: can leadership share the 'decision drivers' for when we prioritize infra vs product work for a customer? Helps Sales set expectations with prospects.
Elena (CEO): Good point. We'll publish a short rubric: impact x reach x cost. Marco + Ravi to co-author.
Priya (Customer Success): :thumbsup: that's super helpful. tagging follow-ups
